description: Generate realistic first and last names for any gender and origin — International, Pakistani, Arabic, Western or Indian. Click any name to copy it.
howto: Choose a gender filter and a name origin.
Select how many names to generate.
Click any name in the list to copy it to your clipboard.
title: Random Name Generator

faqs.a: No. They are randomly combined from built-in first and last name lists, so any resemblance to a real person is a coincidence.

faqs.q: How many names can I generate?
faqs.a: You can generate 5, 10, 20 or 50 names at a time, and run the generator as often as you like.

faqs.q: What are these names good for?
faqs.a: Character names for stories and games, placeholder data for testing software, and naming ideas for projects.
